summary: Inspected the globally installed pi extensions to identify which are solely TUI-related, and answered follow-up questions about gizmo integration and what ui-customization does.
decisions: ui-customization is the only pure TUI renderer; model-info and git-info are supporting data extensions for its dashboard
activity is web-UI-only with a no-op pi extension

model-info and git-info have no dedicated gizmo .web.js extensions, but are not inert in gizmo because they feed ui-customization's combined status and git-info can expose its changed-files view via generic declarative-UI support

In gizmo/RPC mode, ui-customization publishes a combined semantic status (model, provider, thinking level, context usage, session cost, git branch, changed-file count) and sets the session title, rather than installing the custom header/footer
